description: Implementation of memory management functions for the Starboard platform, including allocation, reallocation, deallocation, and reporting functions with version-based conditional compilation.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size using internal implementation.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateNoReport
methods.description: Allocates memory without reporting, calls SbMemoryAllocate.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAligned
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory of specified size and alignment.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocate
methods.description: Reallocates memory to a new size, with safety checks.

methods.name: SbMemoryDeallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory, ensuring reporting occurs first.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocateChecked
methods.description: Reallocates memory and aborts on failure.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAlignedChecked
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory and aborts on failure.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateChecked
methods.description: Allocates memory and aborts on failure.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for memory allocation, chooses checked or unchecked based on macro.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAlignedImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for aligned memory allocation.
